updates.background_zh: CoinEx 是一家全球性加密货币交易所，提供现货交易、永续合约以及资产管理类产品。交易所退出时，对用户而言风险最高的阶段就是提现阶段：在以往的平台关停案例中，曾出现提现失败、资金被锁定数周、用户不得不走人工申领流程的情况，有时还会被收取托管费或账户维护费。正因如此，这类退出公告通常强调尽早提现，而不是等到最后截止日。
updates.background_en: CoinEx is a global cryptocurrency exchange offering spot trading, perpetual futures and asset management products. When an exchange winds down, the riskiest phase for users is the withdrawal period: in past shutdowns, withdrawals have failed, funds have stayed locked for weeks, and users have had to go through manual claims procedures, sometimes with custody or account maintenance fees applying. That history is why exit notices emphasize withdrawing early rather than waiting until the final deadline.
updates.market_impact_zh: 主要传导渠道是流动性：主要在 CoinEx 交易的资产，尤其是小市值代币，会因用户提现并转向更大平台而面临订单簿变薄的问题，而 BTC、ETH 和主流稳定币更可能只是转移到其他交易所。市场情绪层面，交易所偿付能力与托管风险也会受到关注，因为此类关停消息往往会提升用户对整个中心化平台群体的警惕。
updates.market_impact_en: The main transmission channel is liquidity: assets that trade primarily on CoinEx, especially smaller-cap tokens, face thinning order books as users withdraw and migrate to larger venues, while BTC, ETH and major stablecoins are more likely to simply flow to other exchanges. Sentiment around exchange solvency and custody risk is also in play, since shutdown headlines tend to raise user caution across centralized venues more broadly.
